name: Nancy Drew: Mystery of the Seven Keys

locations.note: Adela Černá hires Nancy after the gems in her late mother's necklace turn out to be fakes, and the trail leads to a plot against the Bohemian crown jewels.
Nancy searches the castle square, its obelisk and the statue of St George for clues.
The seven keys guard the crown jewels here; Nancy forges them to trap the thief in the vault.
Nancy photographs the astronomical clock and searches a jewellery shop on the square.
